claim: Weingut Reinhold Haart in Piesport (Ausoniusufer 18, +49 6507 2015) is run by Johannes and Theo Haart, farming nine hectares of Mosel steep slope including the Goldtröpfchen, with tastings by prior appointment.
quote: Today, this historic winery in Piesport, Mosel, is managed by Johannes and Marcus Haart, who oversee nine hectares of steep vineyards and dedicate themselves to producing top-quality rieslings.

claim: Weingut Fritz Haag in Brauneberg (Dusemonder Str. 44, +49 6534 410) farms 19.5 ha of Riesling including the Brauneberger Juffer and Juffer Sonnenuhr grand crus, with tastings pre-arranged by email at info@weingut-fritz-haag.de.
quote: The winery dates back to 1605, and has been run by Oliver Haag and his wife Jessica since the beginning of 2005. The vineyards cover 19.5 hectares of vines with slopes of up to 80%, with eight hectares in the top Brauneberg sites of Juffer and Juffer Sonnenuhr.

claim: Weingut Nik Weis - St. Urbans-Hof in Leiwen (Urbanusstraße 16, +49 6507 93770) offers bookable tastings of Rieslings from five VDP.Grosse Lage sites including a view over Laurentiuslay.
quote: At the winery, you can take a sensory walk through six of the best vineyards of the Moselle and Saar during a wine tasting and enjoy a wonderful view of the VDP.GROSSE LAGE® LAURENTIUSLAY.

claim: Weingut Markus Molitor's Haus Klosterberg vinothek in Bernkastel-Kues charges €20 per person to taste from a list of 40+ wines across 15 sites (Bernkastel, Graach, Wehlen, Zeltingen); appointment required by phone or email (vinothek@markusmolitor.com, +49 6532 954000).
quote: In the special atmosphere of the vinotheque at Klosterberg House... you can enjoy unique wine tastings, choosing your personal selection from more than 40 different wines... The list of wines to taste is €20 per person... appointments are kindly requested in advance.

claim: The St-Nikolaus-Hospital Vinothek in Bernkastel-Kues (Cusanusstr. 2) is the world's largest Mosel-Riesling vinothek, open daily 10:00-18:00 with walk-in tasting 10:00-17:00 at €30 per person spanning over 100 wines.
quote: Wine tasting is available daily between 10 am and 5 pm at 30,00 € per person... The vinotheque in Bernkastel-Kues is located in the vaulted cellars of St Nicholas Hospital and is the largest vinotheque for Moselle Riesling in the world.

claim: Weingut Willi Schaefer in Graach (Hauptstraße 130, +49 6531 8041) farms only 4.2 ha across Graacher Domprobst, Himmelreich and Wehlener Sonnenuhr; visits accepted only April–July by prior appointment, none August–March.
quote: Visits, within their possibilities, are from April to July by prior appointment. No tasting opportunities from August to March.

claim: Weingut Schloss Lieser (Thomas Haag), at Am Markt 1-5 in Lieser, runs a Vinothek/shop Mon-Tue/Thu-Fri 10:00-17:00 and Sat 11:00-15:00; full tastings require advance reservation by email and the estate does not offer cellar or vineyard tours.
quote: The wine shop is open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 10am to 5pm, and Saturday from 11am to 3pm... For a comprehensive wine tasting, advance reservation is required by email... tastings are tasting only and no guided tours of the vineyard or cellar can be offered.

claim: Weingut Selbach-Oster's Vinothek at Gänsfelderstraße 20 in Zeltingen-Rachtig opens Wed-Fri 11:00-17:00 with Mosel-side terraces overlooking Ürziger Würzgarten; six-wine guided tastings on request from €60 minimum, none during harvest until end of October.
quote: Wine tasting sessions include six wines, dry to sweet according to your choice, paired with traditional dishes and appetizers... Wine tastings are offered for smaller groups with a minimum of €60.00.

claim: Weingut Wwe. Dr. H. Thanisch (Erben Thanisch) in Bernkastel-Kues, owner of the legendary Berncasteler Doctor vineyard, opens Mon-Fri 10:00-17:00 and Sat 11:00-16:00; tastings only by prior registration (+49 6531 2282, info@thanisch-vdp.de).
quote: The winery is open Monday–Friday 10 am – 5 pm, Saturday 11 am – 4 pm or by appointment. Wine tastings are only conducted by prior registration by phone (+49 6531 2282) or email.

claim: Moselland eG winegrowers' cooperative Vinothek at Bornwiese 2, Bernkastel-Kues opens Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00 and Sat 09:00-12:00; group tastings on request require minimum 10 people (20 on weekends/holidays).
quote: Opening hours are Monday to Friday: 09:00 - 18:00 o'clock, Saturday: 09:00 - 12:00... Wine tastings are carried out on request. The minimum number of participants is 10 persons, on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays at least 20 persons.

claim: The Piesporter Moselbogen circular hike (~7 km) loops through the Goldtröpfchen steep-slope vineyard along the Mosel, marketed as a wine-and-nature 'Spotlight' trail right in Piesport.
quote: The approximately 7-kilometer circular hike runs in a bow shape through the famous vineyard 'Piesporter Goldtröpfchen' and along the Mosel riverbank.

claim: Walk-in wine venues in Piesport itself include Vinothek Piesport, Weinhaus Hoffmann and the cosy Weinbar am Markt, alongside producers Reinhold Haart, Julian Haart and Reuscher-Haart.
quote: Vinothek Piesport - Offers a wide selection of local wines for tasting and purchase. Weinhaus Hoffmann - Family-run establishment providing expert guidance on Mosel wines. Weinbar am Markt - Cozy wine bar with rotating selections from local producers.

claim: Weingut Clüsserath-Weiler in Trittenheim (Brückenstraße 9), run by Verena Clüsserath on 6.5 ha including Trittenheimer Apotheke, opens Mon-Fri 8:00-18:00 and weekends 8:00-13:00 for on-site tasting in the old barrel cellar.
quote: The winery is located at Brückenstraße 9, D-54349 Trittenheim, and is open Monday-Friday 8-18 Uhr and Saturday/Sunday 8-13 Uhr... Wines can be tasted on site in the old barrel cellar where the noble Clüsserath-Weiler wines mature.

claim: Weingut Schloss Lieser is recognized as a top Mosel VDP estate and one of Bernkastel-Kues region's flagship visitor wineries, set in Lieser village across the river from Brauneberg.
Bernkastel tourism officially lists Weingut Markus Molitor's Haus Klosterberg as a visitor destination within the city of Bernkastel-Kues, around 15 km from Piesport.
